plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin: DE + hallmark enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The data context provides raw gene-level Salmon counts (12000 genes x 12 samples, 6 lesional AD vs 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch) with a flagged low-depth sample (sample_01, ~4x below median library size). Following the grounded procedure: (1) sample-structure QC via blind VST/PCA/distance heatmap to inspect sample_01 without silently dropping it; (2) minimal low-count pre-filter; (3) DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization (size factors absorb the depth difference — no removal by default); (4) DESeq2 Wald test with an explicit reference level (Control) and named contrast (AD_lesional vs Control), cross-checked against edgeR quasi-likelihood as the disputed-robustness alternative; (5) apeglm shrinkage of log2FC for reporting/ranking; (6) BH-adjusted results at padj<0.05 with independent filtering and p-value histogram diagnostic; (7) enrichment: fgsea preranked on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (staged, human, 2026.1) as primary, then Reactome (staged, current) as the named secondary collection, with GO BP as a tertiary follow-up; ORA is explicitly withheld unless >=50 genes pass significance, per the flagged rule; (8) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), DESeq2 vs edgeR overlap, and full reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seed, package/collection versions).
